title: Cairn's own spawns open no console on Windows
intention: Every long-lived process Cairn spawns starts on Windows with no console window, through one shared spawn helper.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: Akien reported 'you keep spinning up python windows, you have at least 4 open now'; of 4 python processes started by bin/cairn's lazy-init, the children 29212 (ground_loop) and 16184 (bus serve) own a console window and the venv launchers that started them do not.
traces_to: CP4 and Law 3 - a measured defect in behaviour on the user's box; Law 1 and Law 4 - one spawn helper in place of six hand-built flag sets, enforced by a proof that greps for bare Popen.
how: New tool windowless_spawn: detached_kwargs() returns creationflags DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP on nt and start_new_session on posix; background_python() returns the base interpreter (or pythonw) rather than the venv launcher on nt. The six Popen sites move onto it. Red-first proof, whose Windows tooth spawns through the venv launcher with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and checks whether the grandchild gets a console.

clauses.claim: the helper's nt kwargs carry CREATE_NO_WINDOW and DETACHED_PROCESS and no start_new_session, and name an interpreter that is not the venv launcher; its posix kwargs carry start_new_session and no creationflags

on Windows a child spawned through the helper from the venv interpreter leaves no process in its tree with a console window; this tooth confirms or kills the venv-launcher hypothesis and reports UNMEASURED on a non-Windows box
none of the six spawn sites calls Popen with a hand-built flag set; each takes its keywords from the helper

decisions.text: D1: a new tool windowless_spawn with a charter beside it; the charter is written before BUILDME crosses.
D2: the six Popen sites take **detached_kwargs() and background_python() from the helper.
D3: one proof, one tooth per clause; tooth 2 is the launcher experiment.

out: devices/web_server/groundloop/pulse.py and cc/scripts/memory_sync.py, which already carry the flags
Claude Code's own shell and hook children

measured.saw: 4 python processes; only children 29212 (ground_loop) and 16184 (bus serve, conhost 16980) have a console window; launchers 25696 and 1648 have none
measured.how: Get-Process MainWindowHandle and Get-CimInstance Win32_Process conhost parents on akiendell

measured.saw: tools/bus_client/remote.py:270 already passes DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW and its child still has a window; six other Popen sites pass only start_new_session
measured.how: git grep of Popen/creationflags over cairn/

measured.saw: HYPOTHESIS, not a measurement: the venv launcher starts the real interpreter as a child without those flags, so the child allocates a console; the proof's tooth 2 tests it
